GLUDICE.Settings.PhysicsEngine.Name: Physics engine
GLUDICE.Settings.PhysicsEngine.Hint: Which physics engine simulates the throws. Rapier is new and still being tested; cannon-es is the original Dice So Nice engine. Every client reloads when this changes.
GLUDICE.Notifications.RapierFallback: GLUniverse Dice: the Rapier physics engine could not start, so dice use cannon-es for this session. See the console for details.
GLUDICE.Settings.IdleRenderSkip.Name: Skip idle frames
GLUDICE.Settings.IdleRenderSkip.Hint: Stop redrawing the dice board while every die is at rest and you are not touching the mouse or keyboard. Saves GPU time while persistent dice sit on the table. Turn it off if dice on the board stop updating.
GLUDICE.Settings.ShaderPrewarm.Name: Prepare dice shaders at load
GLUDICE.Settings.ShaderPrewarm.Hint: After the world loads, build your dice once out of sight so the first throw does not stutter while the graphics driver compiles shaders.
GLUDICE.Settings.EnhancedMaterials.Name: Enhanced materials
GLUDICE.Settings.EnhancedMaterials.Hint: Richer versions of the built-in materials: a clear coat on plastic and wood, colour dispersion in glass and resin, denser velvet, brighter metal. Turn it off to render them exactly as Dice So Nice does. Needs realistic lighting.
GLUDICE.Settings.ImpactParticles.Name: Impact sparks
GLUDICE.Settings.ImpactParticles.Hint: Small sparks where dice hit each other and puffs where they hit the table.
GLUDICE.Settings.SettleGlow.Name: Glowing result number
GLUDICE.Settings.SettleGlow.Hint: When the dice stop, the number on the face that landed up lights up white-hot, then stays glowing while the dice are on the table. Not on d4.
GLUDICE.Settings.GrabAndRoll.Name: Grab and roll
GLUDICE.Settings.GrabAndRoll.Hint: When one of your rolls waits for an interactive throw, its dice float in your hand next to the pointer, and only you see them. Click the hand to throw it, flick it to aim, or shake it and let go. Drag it slowly to move it; Escape throws it. Interactive throws must be allowed by the GM and in your Dice So Nice settings.
GLUDICE.Settings.DiceLinger.Name: Seconds the dice stay on the table
GLUDICE.Settings.DiceLinger.Hint: How long thrown dice stay after they land before they leave, for every player. 0 uses each player's own Dice So Nice setting.
GLUDICE.Settings.BurnAway.Name: Dice burn away
GLUDICE.Settings.BurnAway.Hint: When thrown dice leave the table, they dissolve into white light from the top down, and the glowing result number goes out last. Off: Dice So Nice's own fade or instant hide.
GLUDICE.Settings.ImpactShake.Name: Shake on hard hits
GLUDICE.Settings.ImpactShake.Hint: The board shakes by a few pixels when dice hit the table or each other hard. Off when your system asks for reduced motion.
